newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it kills 40 more Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it kills 40 more Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Government forces have killed 40 Kurdish guerrillas in eastern Turkey, bringing the rebel death toll for clashes in the last two days to 79, security officials said on Friday.
The emergency rule governor's office said in a statement that the latest Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) casualties occurred in fighting in the last two days in the provinces of Elazig and Bingol.
It did not give any figure for military casualties and no independent confirmation of the death toll was available.
Security officials said on Thursday that 39 rebels had died in the provinces of Batman, Sirnak and Bingol.
More than 21,000 people have died in the conflict between Turkish troops and the PKK, fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
